title: Which Cottagecore Aesthetic Are You?
description: Discover your perfect cottagecore aesthetic! From foraging in the forest to baking bread in a sunlit kitchen, find out which cozy lifestyle matches your soul.

forest_forager.title: The Forest Forager
forest_forager.description: You embody the essence of wandering through mossy woods, basket in hand, collecting wild mushrooms and forgotten herbs. Your spirit is wild yet gentle—you find peace among the trees and solace in the earth's quiet offerings. You love the idea of living off the land, brewing teas from foraged plants, and creating natural remedies. Your aesthetic is earthy greens, browns, and the soft golden light that filters through forest canopies.
forest_forager.tip: Try starting a small herb garden or foraging in local parks (safely!) to connect with your forest soul.

baker.title: The Hearth & Knead Baker
baker.description: Your sanctuary is a sun-drenched kitchen filled with the aroma of freshly baked bread, crumbling pastries, and simmering preserves. You find joy in the meditative act of kneading dough and the satisfaction of watching something transform in the oven. Your aesthetic is warm amber tones, flour-dusted countertops, and handcrafted pottery. You believe the best things in life are made with patience and love.
baker.tip: Experiment with sourdough starter or try making preserves from seasonal fruits—your kitchen awaits!

herbalist.title: The Cottage Herbalist
herbalist.description: You are drawn to the ancient wisdom of plants and healing. Your cottage is filled with drying herbs, tincture bottles, and leather-bound journals of botanical knowledge. You believe in slow living and the power of natural remedies. Your aesthetic includes dried flower arrangements, apothecary jars, and soft linen fabrics. You find purpose in caring for others through nature's gifts.
herbalist.tip: Start learning about local medicinal plants or try making your own herbal tea blends.

artist.title: The Meadow Artist
artist.description: Beauty flows through your fingertips as naturally as water through a stream. You're inspired by the wild meadows, the delicate petals of wildflowers, and the play of light across pastoral landscapes. Your aesthetic includes watercolors, pressed flowers, and hand-lettered poems. You see the world through an artistic lens and find wonder in the simplest moments—a butterfly resting on a petal, morning dew on a spider web.
artist.tip: Try pressing flowers or keeping a nature journal to capture the beauty you see everywhere.

shepherd.title: The Gentle Shepherd
shepherd.description: Your heart belongs to the rolling hills and gentle creatures that roam them. You dream of a life surrounded by sheep, chickens, and perhaps a loyal dog by your side. You find satisfaction in simple, honest work and the rhythm of rural life. Your aesthetic includes wool, linen, and the soft bleating of farm animals at dawn. You value self-sufficiency and the deep connection that comes from caring for living things.
shepherd.tip: Consider volunteering at a local farm or starting a small vegetable garden to nurture your pastoral dreams.

bookworm.title: The Fireside Bookworm
bookworm.description: Your idea of perfect bliss is curled up with a worn favorite book, a cup of tea, and the crackling warmth of a fire. You cherish quiet moments of reflection and the wisdom found in stories old and new. Your aesthetic is floor-to-ceiling bookshelves, reading nooks bathed in lamplight, and handwritten marginalia. You believe in the magic of words and the worlds they open.
bookworm.tip: Start a reading corner with soft blankets and fairy lights—your perfect escape awaits.
